Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.svek

Class RoleLabels

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.svek.RoleLabels
public final class RoleLabels extends Object
Role labels of an association (A "1"/"-owner" --> B), shared by all the layout engines (Graphviz, Smetana and ELK).
  • create(java.lang.String, net.sourceforge.plantuml.skin.Pragma, net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.font.FontConfiguration, net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.ISkinParam) builds the text block, turning a leading visibility character into the same icon as the one used for class attributes.
  • getPosition(net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.geom.XDimension2D, net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.geom.XDimension2D, net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.geom.XPoint2D, net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.geom.XPoint2D, net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.geom.XPoint2D, java.util.Collection<net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.geom.XPoint2D>, java.util.Collection<net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.geom.RectangleArea>) decides where the block is drawn: on the other side of the line from the quantifier, and never on top of the line.

    • create

    • getPosition

      public static XPoint2D getPosition(XDimension2D qDim, XDimension2D rDim, XPoint2D quantifierPos, XPoint2D thisEndpoint, XPoint2D otherEndpoint, Collection<XPoint2D> pathSamples, Collection<RectangleArea> obstacles)
      Computes the top-left corner of the role label. The role is preferably drawn on the other side of the line from the quantifier, at the same height (or at the same abscissa for a horizontal line). If this collides with one of the obstacles (typically the node the line is attached to: a line leaving a node diagonally can have its "other side" inside the node), the role is moved to the closest place where it has some room.
      Parameters:
      qDim - size of the quantifier, which is drawn at quantifierPos by the layout engine
      rDim - size of the role
      thisEndpoint - end of the line where the label is attached
      otherEndpoint - the opposite end of the line
      pathSamples - points of the line, or null to use the straight segment between the two endpoints
      obstacles - areas to keep free, in the same coordinates as the other parameters (may be empty)
